 selectInput("player", "Player:",

messages.subject: Re: Populating a selectInput
parts:
Oh, I see. You can create a file called global.R in the same directory as server.R and ui.R; any variables that you define there will be visible from both files. (Unlike server.R and ui.R, though, when you make changes to global.R you need to stop and restart the Shiny app for them to take effect.)

(Sorry, it appears this is not documented yet, I don't think anybody else has actually needed this functionality so far.)

messages.subject: Re: Populating a selectInput
parts:
Oh, in that case, at the top of ui.R:

playerChoices <- df$id
names(playerChoices) <- df$name

then pass playerChoices as the choices argument to selectInput.
